english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, attitude, or mood that expects a positive outcome.
This is the all-purpose choice when “rosy” means optimistic about the future.
Use this when the cheerful quality specifically comes from an optimistic outlook.
Use this specifically for a person, attitude, or outlook that expects good things to happen.
Use this for someone whose general outlook is optimistic rather than specifically focused on one hoped-for result.

examples.english: Even when plans do not go as hoped, I’m still optimistic.
examples.traditional: 就算計劃未如理想，我都仲係好樂觀。
